request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Which categories of machinery always require a conformity assessment procedure involving a notified body?

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards", "Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices", "Vehicle servicing lifts", "Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery", "Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions", "Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems"], "text": "Under Article 25(2) and Annex I, Part A of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, six categories must follow a procedure involving a notified body: EU type-examination (module B), full quality assurance (module H), or unit verification (module G). Part B categories can use internal production control without a notified body when harmonised standards are applied, so they are not included.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 25(2)", "quote": "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A", "quote": "PART A Categories of machinery or related products to which a procedure referred to in Article 25(2) shall be applied: 1. Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards. 2. Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices. 3. Vehicle servicing lifts. 4. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery. 5. Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions. 6. Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems."}]}
